messages:
maya (billing): quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw staggered ingest causing delayed token counts for ~3 customers yesterday. need clear owners for credits, invoice corrections, and a recurring detection rule.
liam (eng-infra): noted. i can take the detection rule and a dashboard. ETA EOD tomorrow. planning to add a TTL on the ingest queue and an alert if lag > 5m.
arjun (finance): thanks @liam. i'll own credits and invoice corrections. can we get a clean list of affected customers + token deltas? i need that to run adjustments and communicate to AR.
maya (billing): arjun — attaching the initial list below. this is preliminary; liam's detection will refine it.
maya (billing): ```csv
customer_id,window_start,window_end,reported_tokens,actual_tokens,delta
cust_44,2026-03-21T09:00Z,2026-03-21T11:30Z,12450,9800,-2650
cust_19,2026-03-21T10:15Z,2026-03-21T12:05Z,23000,21700,-1300
```
jordan (eng-sre): from the SRE side, the pattern looks like a retry storm from the QueueConsumer v2 when there was transient Redis throttling. i can add circuit breaking and better backoff. estimate 2 d for rollout; will stage canary on dedicated.
sophia (customer-success): heads-up — i'll draft customer comms for the ones getting credits. prefer short note + credit amount. pls flag if any customers cannot be auto-adjusted.
liam (eng-infra): quick note: detection rule will emit an event to #metering-alerts and create a ticket in JIRA (MET-xxx). sample signal: "ingest_lag_ms > 300000 and token_delta < -500".
arjun (finance): perfect. once detection triggers, i'll reconcile with ledger and queue a manual review for edge cases. will prepare a credit memo template.
maya (billing): action items recap: 1) liam — detection rule + dashboard + alert -> EOD tomorrow; 2) jordan — backoff/circuit-breaker -> PR in 48h, rollout in 2d; 3) arjun — credit memos + invoice corrections -> start after detection list, complete in 3 business days; 4) sophia — customer comms draft -> initial draft in 24h.
liam (eng-infra): adding: i'll include a counter for "staggered_ingest_window" so we can histogram by sequence length.
arjun (finance): question — for credits, do we apply gross token delta or round to nearest 100? need policy.
maya (billing): good call. policy: round to nearest 50 tokens for low-value accounts, nearest 500 for enterprise (> $50k/mo). i'll update the runbook.
jordan (eng-sre): FYI i'm seeing ~0.6% of requests hit the path that caused delay last week. i'll include a regression test.
sophia (customer-success): i'll wait for your list @maya and then tailor messages. can we do a short FAQ about how credits appear on invoices?
arjun (finance): i'll add example line items to the memo template.
billing-bot: Incident MET-2026-03121: staggered-ingest detected for 2 customers, created ticket MET-4427.
maya (billing): thanks all. i'll own the postmortem follow-up doc and update owners/timestamps. next sync in 48h or when MET-4427 moves to In Progress. :thumbsup:
